g.text: AppWorld API protocol pilot: four paired train tasks

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: Train/dev pilot | 4 paired tasks | 1 seed(s) | Full KV, N=1

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: Pointwise 95% intervals: bounded task means for success/error rates; task bootstrap for duration.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: Completed execution can still fail evaluation. Fewer errors or shorter attempts do not establish better task performance.

g.text: Error-rate coverage: Control: 4/4 tasks; Candidate: 4/4 tasks. Measured-duration coverage: Control: 4/4 tasks; Candidate: 4/4 tasks.
